note: G158 recolour manifest (tools/recolor_parts.py, docs/25). families = hue families of the GPT art (anchor = median colour measured on the parts); a palette maps each family to one of its roles or a colour (null = keep). The gingham ribbon and the sunflowers share one hue band (62–97°) and cannot be split by colour: lemon and rust palettes recolour both together (natural sunflower colours); navy / burgundy / dusty-blue palettes keep the sunflowers and send every part where gingham and sunflower meet to GPT (palette.json recolor). Pure gingham parts (envelope liner, small card border) recolour on their own; kraft (chroma below the cmin) stays.
